decision.observation: Clicking to build produced 'MISSING RESOURCES — METAL ORE: 200 KG' with a BACK button, even though the Resources panel lists Copper Ore at 340.3 kg. In this game this usually means the ore isn't reachable for delivery.
decision.hypothesis: The mined copper ore is lying on the ground somewhere dupes can't path to (e.g. below the ladder or in the flooded lower level), so the diffuser can't be supplied until it's collected or swept.
